text.tspan: derived-credit
Reserve consumer custody before exchanging pending
into active batch; clear is not callback completion
target-accept
Successful producer admission pins the immutable
target domain before descriptor access; Close denies
only new entrants
pending-publish
Accepted producer may publish after Close; stable
domain owns pending until claim or exclusive
coordinator drain
storage-commit
Retire after producer gate closed and drained,
consumer gate sealed and drained, pending empty,
writer and root custody settled
claim-seal
Seal normal claim admission only after producers
drain; existing reservations finish; coordinator
owns residual pending
activation-root
Vector load to registered activation root is a no-
safepoint interval; collection scans and rewrites
that slot
vector-writer
Root setter argument before queueing; close external
admission; derived request holds parent claim until
rendezvous commit; preserve selected roots
gc-move
All participating contexts parked with no unrooted
load; rewrite global vector, selected activations
and queued setter argument

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: native-operations
Four RMW plus one load is a proposed uncontended
protocol count, not a native instruction or latency
bound
claim-operations
Three RMW plus one load; empty claims still pay;
unknown outcomes retain rather than replay
vector-gc
k excludes existing scanned registers and frames;
rendezvous cost grows with roster; setter frequency and
GC cost must be included
net-benefit
No speed gain established; benefit requires avoided
real lifetime failures or eliminated work to exceed
additional atomics, rendezvous and scans; Zig does not
remove these obligations
